Kids Game: Signal in the Static — Everyone hums, chatters and shuffles — that's the noise. One child hides a beeping timer or shaker somewhere in the hall. The room has to go quiet enough, in stages, to hear it and find it. Repeat with the noise starting louder each time. WHY IT FITS: You cannot hear the quiet thing until you stop making noise.
Kids Game Equipment: Kitchen timer or a shaker; something to hide it under
Kids Game Under-5 Adaptation: Under-5s are the noise-makers and the finders. Hide it in plain sight and let them 'find' it. Skip the staged quiet — just loud, then whisper, then silent.

NZ Alternative Note: Practical ways to find the pause before reacting.

Kids Game Under-5 Adaptation: Under-5s just do stop-and-go with a big breath. Drop the feelings round or use only two: happy and sleepy.
